title: CHAPTER 044 - Handover to v3.7 native project orchestrator
description: Downloads and validates the prepublished v3.7 runner and project.json, backs up current runner/state, arms a post-finalize helper, then hands ownership from v3.6 to v3.7 after this task reaches SUCCESS.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$runner=$root+'/3en-agent-runner-v3.7.ps1';$project=$root+'/project.json';$helper=$root+'/handover-to-v37.ps1';Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3en4all/3en-command-runner/main/3en-agent-runner-v3.7.ps1' -OutFile $runner;Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3en4all/3en-command-runner/main/project.json' -OutFile $project;$tok=$null;$err=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($runner,[ref]$tok,[ref]$err)|Out-Null;Write-Host ('V37_SYNTAX_ERRORS='+@($err).Count);if(@($err).Count-ne0){throw 'v3.7 syntax invalid'};$pj=Get-Content -LiteralPath $project -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($pj.projectId-ne'2026-09-09-stress-031-040'){throw 'project manifest mismatch'};Write-Host ('PROJECT_CHAPTER_COUNT='+@($pj.chapters).Count);if(@($pj.chapters).Count-ne10){throw 'project must contain 10 chapters'};$oldPid=$PID;$helperText=@"`n`$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'`n`$root='C:/3EN-Agent'`n`$deadline=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(5)`nwhile((Get-Date)-lt `$deadline){`n  try{`$s=Get-Content -LiteralPath (`$root+'/3en-agent.state.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(`$s.lastExecutedId-eq'2026-09-09-044' -and `$s.lastTerminalStatus-eq'SUCCESS'){break}}catch{}`n  Start-Sleep -Seconds 2`n}`nStart-Sleep -Seconds 12`nStop-Process -Id $oldPid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`nStart-Sleep -Seconds 2`nStart-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',(`$root+'/3en-agent-runner-v3.7.ps1'),'-ProjectPath','project.json')`n"@;Set-Content -LiteralPath $helper -Encoding UTF8 -Value $helperText;$t2=$null;$e2=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($helper,[ref]$t2,[ref]$e2)|Out-Null;Write-Host ('HANDOVER_HELPER_SYNTAX_ERRORS='+@($e2).Count);if(@($e2).Count-ne0){throw 'handover helper syntax invalid'};$hp=Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$helper) -PassThru;Write-Host ('HANDOVER_HELPER_PID='+$hp.Id);Write-Host 'V37_HANDOVER_ARMED=TRUE'
rollback: Write-Host 'Rollback: v3.6 remains active until 044 reaches SUCCESS; backup preserved under C:/3EN-Agent/backups/044.'
